description: Run failing unit tests in a Python project using VSCode's Testing panel. The project is located at /home/ga/workspace/pytest_project and contains a calculator module with unit tests. Some tests are failing due to bugs in the code. Your task: (1) Open the Testing panel by clicking the flask icon on the left Activity Bar or using View → Testing menu, (2) Wait for VSCode to discover the tests automatically - you should see test_calculator.py with 5 tests, (3) Identify which tests have red X icons indicating failures, (4) Run at least one specific failing test by clicking the play button icon next to it to see the detailed error output, (5) Optionally run all tests to see the full picture. The tests use pytest framework. DO NOT modify the source code or test files - your goal is to RUN and INTERPRET the tests, not fix the bugs. The Testing panel will show test results with green checkmarks for passing tests and red X marks for failing tests.
